fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front headlights
Dust and grime on the dashboard top and center stack
Peeling/worn finish on the center stack trim near the left vent
Spots and light staining on the passenger seat cushion
Dirty, dusty rubber floor mats in front footwells
Dusty door panels and light gray interior plastics
Faded black plastic on the rear bumper step pad and tailgate handle trim
Light scuffs on the rear bumper
Dull, flat-looking silver paint on hood and sides
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Jeep Liberty. The headlights look pretty yellowed in the photos and the light gray interior has some dust and a few spots on the passenger seat. We do mobile pre-sale details including headlight restoration and interior cleaning, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
